summary: Iter47 tested 6 features. PASSED: (1) Backend GET /api/marketplace/announcements/history returns {announcements, total} sorted newest→oldest, capped at 200, no _id; empty state works; ascend inserts entry visible in history. (2) /ascensions page renders (ascension-history-page + ascensions-total + ascensions-empty when 0) with marketplace-chronicle-link navigating correctly from /marketplace. (3) /glyphs Chord Mode toggle text switches '○ Enter Chord Mode' ↔ '◉ Chord Mode — select sigils', 3 glyph cards selectable, ring-chord-btn shows '♫ Ring the Chord (3 sigils)' enabled, click doesn't error; toggle-off resets. (4) /codex reading progress: starts '0/16 read', opening 2 books → '2/16 read', persists across reload, deep link ?book=IX marks it read (localStorage=['I','II','IX']). (5) Street Vybz game (iframe /api/games/streets/play): ctrlHint contains 'V talk to Vybz'; spawnVybz/talkVybz/updateVybz are functions; VYBZ_MISSIONS.length===3; after start vybz is object with idx=0 and taggers array; simulated teleport (S.x=-72,S.z=66) + talkVybz() activates Mission 0 'MARK YOUR TERRITORY' and spawns 3 taggers (vybz.taggers.length===3); zero JS console errors during 5s+ gameplay. (6) Regression: /marketplace 200, /ops 200, frontend compiles (no ConstellationMap.jsx syntax errors). FAILED: /codex/constellation search UI is entirely missing — the state hooks (q, matches, flyTo) exist in ConstellationMap.jsx lines 39–46 but no <input data-testid='constellation-search-input'> or search-results dropdown is rendered anywhere in the JSX return. Constellation map itself still works (101 stars, zoom, hover card, drag-pan).

ui_bugs.issue: Search UI not rendered — the file defines q/setQ, matches, and flyTo() (lines 39-46) but never renders an <input data-testid='constellation-search-input'>, a results dropdown (constellation-search-results), or result items (constellation-search-result-N). Feature is dead code — user cannot search stars.

critical_code_review_comments: ConstellationMap.jsx: search state/logic present but no UI — either add the input+dropdown or remove dead state to reduce noise.
AscensionHistory.jsx: single fetch with no auth header — works because the endpoint is public, but no loading-error state distinguished from empty (both show empty). Minor.
Codex.jsx toggleBook only calls markRead when opening a new book (open !== i), so clicking an already-open book to close it doesn't re-mark (fine, but subtle).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_iter47_hist_* marketplace item + its ascension announcement; cleaned both from db.marketplace and db.announcements at end of test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter47 shipped 5 features clean (history endpoint, /ascensions page, chronicle link, chord mode, codex progress, VYBZ game). The ONE missing piece is the constellation search UI — state + flyTo helper exist in ConstellationMap.jsx (~line 39-46) but no <input>/dropdown is in the JSX. After main agent adds the UI, re-test: type 'apex' → constellation-search-result-35 appears + click flies to CG-v35; type 'v121' → finds Omniversal-Absolute-Unbeing; Enter flies to first match. For game iframe testing, use `await page.query_selector('[data-testid="game-frame"]')` then `content_frame()` — the direct page.frames indexing is unreliable; frame url is /api/games/streets/play.
